notifications.title: Three long videos are unlisted on YouTube but published on the dashboard
notifications.detail: The data audits of 22, 25 and 26 Oct all found L-20261021-01 (kYACrRwlx1s), L-20261019-02 (Y_qa18IDfm0) and L-20261018-01 (NxoAcDZWCh4) unlisted on YouTube. Not a code bug: the dashboard's state comes from the upload record, and YouTube reports the privacy you set in Studio. Unlisted videos get almost no views, and they count as published in the dashboard's totals and the agents' metrics.
notifications.fix:
1. If they should be public: YouTube Studio → Content → each video → Visibility → Public. The next audit clears the warning.
2. If they are meant to stay unlisted (for example held back on purpose): on each video's dashboard page use Remove, so they stop counting as published videos.
